name: opens100
description: Core C++ library for IHO S-100 hydrographic data. The base package is the geodesy module (opens100::latlon); the other modules are features.

apps.description: Command line programs: opens100-render draws datasets as a PNG file from a JSON job file (tools/opens100)

coverage.description: S-100 Part 10c HDF5 coverage reader and water level adjustment (opens100::coverage)

dataset.description: S-100 dataset model and readers: S-101 ISO 8211 cells, GML and HDF5 datasets (opens100::dataset)

feature-catalogue.description: S-100 Part 5 feature catalogue model and reader (opens100::featurecatalog)

geometry.description: Geometry primitives, map scaler and display settings (opens100::geometry)

lua-scripting.description: Lua session of S-100 Part 9a portrayal on LuaJIT (Lua 5.1): host-call table and drawing instruction results (opens100::luascripting)

portrayal.description: Portrayal run: the rules of a portrayal catalogue (Lua for S-101, XSLT otherwise) turn a dataset into S-100 Part 9 drawing instructions; no renderer (opens100::portrayal)

portrayal-catalogue.description: S-100 Part 9 portrayal catalogue model and reader: rules, viewing groups, display modes, context parameters (opens100::portrayalcatalogue)

render-skia.description: Skia backend of the renderer: draws the drawing instructions on a Skia canvas, CPU raster and PNG output included (opens100::render-skia)

view.description: A view of layers: datasets opened as layers, their drawing order, grids, exchange catalogues and the System Database chart, drawn on a frame a backend supplies (opens100::view)

view-skia.description: The frame of a view on Skia: a view drawn with no window, as a PNG file; on Windows also onto a device context (opens100::view-skia)

system-database.description: System Database: local store of installed datasets, catalogues and support files, and S-100 Part 15 data protection (opens100::sdb)
